## Overview

Given an agent, they assess its usefulness, draft a report, and present a better one.

This is in two parts:

1. Assessment and communication of given agent
2. Revision, experimentation, and assessment of new agent

## Requirements

1. The work of analysis, revision, and testing
2. A written report and summary
3. Codebase for revised agent
4. Video communicating results to client
5. Meeting with employer (the professor)

## Notes

AI is allowed to help them write the report and summary, but it better not sound like AI wrote it

You could have them share tips with each other on how to make AI output quality
